title: Stability, security & UX — crash fixes, accurate group counts, faster on old phones
summary: Big round across all platforms: fixed a real-device iOS crash on group media, hardened security (Windows deps bumped past CVE-2023-5217, DB key never stored in plaintext, several pentest findings closed), made group member/online counts accurate and consistent across clients, auto-recovering and faster group/1:1 file transfers, full-length messages via chunking, Telegram-style single voice playback, camera-from-attach, and a performance pass that removes freezes on older Android phones. iOS via TestFlight (build 142852); Android and Desktop on the mirrors and GitHub.

changes.title: iOS — crash on sending/receiving group media fixed
changes.description: Sending a group photo or voice message, or retrying a photo, crashed on real devices (iPhone 16/17 Pro Max, iOS 26.6). Root cause: legacy group-file helpers queried the default (unencrypted) Realm, which became unmigratable after a schema bump and threw on every group file transfer. The default Realm config now self-heals. Confirmed fixed.

changes.title: Desktop (Windows) — bundled media/crypto libraries updated past known CVEs
changes.description: libvpx 1.11.0 → 1.14.0 (fixes CVE-2023-5217, a VP8 heap overflow), OpenSSL → 1.1.1w, FFmpeg → 4.4.5. The Windows cross-build was repaired end-to-end (libvpx mingw link, x264 build step, WinRT api-set false-positive) so these patched libraries actually ship.

changes.title: Security audit fixes (pentest findings closed)
changes.description: DB encryption key is no longer written to disk in plaintext — recovery uses a device-bound encrypted backup (NEW-3). Push-relay trusted-proxy handling so a client can't spoof its source IP (NEW-4). UnifiedPush URL validation tightened (NEW-1). Desktop image preview rejects decode-bombs and drops SVG (D-2). Filename/path-traversal hardening (D-3). NGC incoming-video bounds checks, ~30fps rate-limit and thread-safe peer map (D-4/5/6). Windows credential store NUL-terminates the user name (buffer over-read).

changes.title: iOS — sending video to a group fixed
changes.description: Videos picked for a group silently never sent: the file was copied on a background queue after the picker's temporary URL had already been deleted. The copy now happens synchronously while the URL is valid (photos were unaffected).

changes.title: Group member & online counts are now accurate and consistent
changes.description: Different clients showed different participant/online numbers for the same group. Both Android and iOS now read the counts straight from toxcore's NGC-synced group state (online peers incl. self + saved offline members), so clients converge on the same 'N members · M online'. The group-info screen and the in-group header also now agree.

changes.title: Group file transfers auto-recover (no more manual retry)
changes.description: A single dropped chunk left a group file stuck until the user tapped a retry circle. The receiver now re-requests missing chunks every few seconds (parity with iOS) instead of once per 30s, so transfers self-heal.

changes.title: Long messages send in full instead of being truncated
changes.description: Messages over ~1.3 KB were silently cut off. Long messages to an online friend are now split into chunks and reassembled on the other side; Saved Messages keep the full text. Pasting a very long message no longer freezes the input either.

changes.title: iOS — private (in-group direct) messages are surfaced
changes.description: A private message sent to you inside a group used to land silently with no alert. It now notifies like any message, titled '🔒 <sender> (private)', so you can tell it was addressed to you personally.

changes.title: Android — no more freezes on older phones
changes.description: Switching tabs/groups and opening busy chats could freeze the UI. Chat history now loads off the UI thread (1:1 and groups); per-row work in the chat/group lists (member counts, unread badges, icon drawables) is cached. Noticeably smoother on low-end devices.

changes.title: 1:1 files are accepted automatically
changes.description: Incoming files in a direct chat no longer show an accept/decline prompt — they download immediately, in both directions.

changes.title: Voice messages — only one plays at a time
changes.description: Starting a voice message now pauses whichever one was playing (Telegram-style), in both 1:1 and group chats.

changes.title: Message a group member privately
changes.description: Tapping a member opens their info with a clear 'Send private message' field and button (previously a hidden debug field that only sent on exit).

changes.title: Camera straight from the attach button
changes.description: The attach (paperclip) action now offers Camera (photo) / Record video / Gallery, so you can shoot and send media without leaving the chat.

changes.title: Send time shown for media in private/saved chats
changes.description: Voice messages, photos and videos in 1:1 and Saved Messages now show their send time, like text messages.

changes.title: Add-contact screen — Android-style on iOS, 'Paste ID' hint
changes.description: The iOS add-contact page now matches Android: 'Paste ID' field, 'Scan QR code' and a new 'Scan QR code from gallery' (decode a saved photo), plus a help line. Android ID hint renamed to 'Вставьте ID'.

changes.title: Connection-type diagnostic for group peers
changes.description: A peer's info now shows whether you reach them directly (UDP) or via a relay (TCP) — helpful for understanding transfer speed.

changes.title: Bootstrap from public Tox DHT nodes
changes.description: Both Android and iOS now bootstrap from the proven public Tox DHT (tox.abilinski.com, mf-net.eu, tox.initramfs.io, …) instead of self-hosted bootstrap nodes, so joining no longer depends on our own infra being reachable. The push.khandaq.org wake relay (FCM/APNs) is a separate role and is unchanged.

changes.title: Android — delivery status (checkmarks) on photos, videos, voice & files
changes.description: Outgoing media now shows the same status indicator as text: a clock while queued/awaiting the peer, a single check while transferring, and a double check once the recipient has pulled the whole file (real delivery for P2P transfers). Canceled transfers show no indicator.

changes.title: Android — faster group connect / reconnect
changes.description: Opening a group chat now forces an immediate reconnect of a stalled group instead of waiting out the back-off, and the automatic retry of a stuck announce starts at 6s instead of 15s. Rate-limited and connecting-safe, so it never interrupts an announce already in progress. Less time stuck on "Connecting…".

changes.title: Android — profile import no longer freezes and fully replaces old data
changes.description: Importing a .tox profile used to block the UI thread while waiting for the network to stop (it felt frozen / "very slow") and, worse, only partly wiped the previous profile — old messages, files, transfers and relays were left behind and mixed into the imported account. Import now runs in the background behind a progress dialog and clears every table, so the imported profile comes in clean. Combined with the earlier fix, contacts keep their real names instead of becoming "friend #N".
